answer: Tie each identity to a single jade-sealed hardware key issued only after a slow verification step, and let a plume-light reputation trail accumulate solely from attested useful work. Agents may wander between services carrying that one credential, but they cannot clone it cheaply. A genuine agent registers once and builds standing over time, while a Sybil operator must repeat the slow verification and the hardware cost for every fake identity, so mass forgery costs real time and money per account instead of a free copy.
